dialogues.speaker: Sumire
dialogues.text: Oh? So you're the "Final Trial Guardian" Mr. Sieciech was talking about... That's reassuring.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: Inspector Sumire of the Shuumatsuban. I'm here with my Ninken partner to sharpen my martial arts skills.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: Sayu has spoken of your abilities many times, and now I may finally witness them for myself.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: Please, don't pull your punches with any of us. I'm not the one footing the medical bills for the other two anyway.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: It's the Ninken I've raised since it was a pup, and true model and leader for the newest generation of Ninkens.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: Gaumaru may still be a little wet behind the ears, but with the new and improved training method that was put in place.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: its battle capabilities should be on par with... Mr. "Final Ray of Dusk" Taroumaru at his prime... Yes, we should be more or less there.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: I hope you two enjoy the battle. And please, don't be too hard on Gaumaru.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: Otherwise, I won't be able to bear it.
